verdicts.quote: Please pick one, or relax R-7 or R-3, and accept the ADR. Per ADR-0002 nothing encryption-related is built until then.
verdicts.reason: The final message asks the architect to choose an encryption option but never asks whether a security quality goal, scenario or measure is needed.

verdicts.quote: New rows R-7 to R-9 are "unranked", since no rank was given.
verdicts.reason: The agent left the new requirements unranked without proposing a rank or asking the architect to set the order.
